goals.title: Довести текущий Android Compose + Kotlin Spring кассовый проект Vitbo...
goals.objective: Довести текущий Android Compose + Kotlin Spring кассовый проект Vitbon KKM до проверяемого рабочего среза РФ кассы: продажа товаров с оплатой наличными, банковской картой и СБП; фискализация только после подтверждения безналичной оплаты; чек/синхронизация/отчеты отражают cash/card/sbp; UI кассира показывает доступные способы оплаты и состояния ожидания/отказа; реальные эквайринг/СБП/ОФД интеграции оформляются через адаптеры и sandbox/fake implementations без ложного утверждения продакшен-подключения без договоров, ключей и оборудования. Use bead vitbon-kassa-oiw. Required criteria: happy card/SBP/cash sale; edge declined/timeout payment must not fiscalize paid receipt; regression reports and sync preserve payment totals; manual QA through Android/emulator or HTTP backend as applicable.

successCriteria.scenario: Computer-use Android QA: launch debug APK on emulator, login/use debug product, choose CARD then SBP then CASH in Sales screen, tap ПРОДАТЬ; PASS if card/SBP routes through payment approval before fiscal success and cash succeeds directly, with UI showing success and reports totals including card/sbp/cash.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C001-android-payment-happy.txt plus RED output for SalesViewModel payment-pipeline test and GREEN output after implementation.

successCriteria.scenario: Computer-use Android QA: configure sandbox terminal/SBP to decline/timeout, attempt CARD/SBP sale from Sales screen with one cart item; PASS if saleResult is TerminalError, cart remains visible, syncService.onCheckCreated is not called, and no fiscal/check success is shown.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C002-android-payment-failure.txt plus RED output for declined/timeout ViewModel pipeline test and GREEN output after implementation.

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP backend QA: start backend test profile or bootRun with H2, POST authenticated checks/sync containing cash/card/sbp sales, then GET /api/v1/reports/sales; PASS if response has totalRevenue equal to cash+card+sbp and separate cashRevenue/cardRevenue/sbpRevenue.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C003-backend-report-regression.http plus GREEN output for CheckServiceSalesReportTest and relevant integration test.

codexObjective: Complete the durable ulw-loop plan in .omo/ulw-loop/goals.json, including later accepted/appended stories, under the original brief constraints; use .omo/ulw-loop/ledger.jsonl as the audit trail.
